recognize_zh: 視野中有數個大型母細胞，核染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性，其中央一個細胞的細胞質內可見較粗大的紫色顆粒；在 t(8;21) AML 中，顆粒融合形成的大顆粒稱為假性 Chédiak-Higashi 顆粒（pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules），但此放大倍率下巨大顆粒解析有限。
features: Several large blasts with high to intermediate N:C ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, and fine chromatin
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm; one central blast shows coarse, enlarged purple cytoplasmic granules
Adjacent granulated cell with pink-lilac granular cytoplasm (maturing myeloid cell)
Background of normochromic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Smear shows several large blasts with fine chromatin, occasional nuclear indentation, and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, together with scattered small lymphocytes and a maturing granulated myeloid cell. One centrally placed blast contains coarse, enlarged cytoplasmic granules, compatible with the fused granules described as pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules, although truly giant inclusions are not clearly resolved at this magnification. No Auer rods are identified in this field. In the setting of RUNX1::RUNX1T1, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21) showing abnormal granule fusion.

ddx.vs: Giant granules occur in mature neutrophils, lymphocytes, and monocytes of a child with albinism and immunodeficiency, not selectively in leukemic blasts.
Abnormal promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, heavy azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus, and bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells).
Dark granules are in mature neutrophils and bands during infection, without an increase in blasts.
